verdicts.reason: A: the logo is shrunk until it nearly disappears in the dark panel, so the SOLSTICE wordmark can't be read and the brand is effectively lost. Its CTA button is tiny, and 'Ships late June' is set larger than the button label, which inverts the hierarchy; the body and legal copy are crammed into one illegible column, with the legal text unreadable. B: the logo is a readable size, the CTA button is prominent, and the orange divider is kept, so it reads left to right properly. Its flaws: the headline is set smaller and denser than A's, 'solstice.' is left orphaned on its own line in the body copy, and the legal text is microscopic and pressed against the bottom edge.
